title: 2 July 1962: Live: Plaza Ballroom, St Helens
content:
Following their successful appearance on 25 June, The Beatles returned to the Plaza Ballroom for a second show.

This was the first of four consecutive Monday night performances at the venue, which was run by the Whetstone Entertainment company.
